author: Nerdstalgic
description:
Every year, the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences comes together at The Oscars to give out awards to the years best films.  Most of the time the top prize of Best Picture goes to the film that stands out above the rest.  But sometimes The Oscars completely misses the mark, and lets a golden opportunity pass them by. 

#academyawards #theoscars #crash #nerdstalgic
title: The Worst Best Picture Winner In Oscar History #movie
